name: Family Company
source:
You got a job at a good firm and now you have to find your place in the team. It won't be easy but you need to find a way to get along with all the beautiful ladies. Slutty Corp has been given a name change and is now known as Family Company.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/family-company]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一家不错的公司找到了工作，现在必须在团队里找到自己的位置。这并不容易，但你得设法与这些美丽的女士们好好相处。本作原名《Slutty Corp》，现已更名为《Family Company》。

[摘自[url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/family-company]itch.io[/url]]
